Show differences in sets of settings — rstudio_compare_user_settings
text: One : "bio-default", "rstudio-default" (unambiguous abbreviation ). source One : "auto" (default): use live RStudio session one running, otherwise fall back saved preferences file. "live": read "current" settings live via rstudioapi::readRStudioPreference(); fails gracefully RStudio running. "file": always read "current" settings saved rstudio-prefs.json file disk, even RStudio running. output One : "minimal": print match/difference counts. "concise" (default): print many settings match, plus short list differs. "verbose": fall back full waldo::compare() output (useful deep debugging, can verbose large preference sets).

title: Show differences in sets of settings — rstudio_compare_user_settings
text: Invisibly, data frame per-key comparison results ("concise"/"minimal"), waldo::compare() result ("verbose"). Settings, list, displayed . Returns invisible(NULL) requested source unavailable (e.g. "live" without running RStudio session, "file"/"auto" saved preferences file).

title: Show differences in sets of settings — rstudio_compare_user_settings
text: source = "live" ("auto" RStudio running) reads "current" settings live via rstudioapi::readRStudioPreference(). source = "file" ("auto" without RStudio running) reads saved rstudio-prefs.json file disk (see get_path_rstudio_config_file()). Since file stores values overridden RStudio's built-defaults, keys left default also filled (possible) local RStudio installation's user-prefs-schema.json, misreported "missing". file-based comparison may still reflect unsaved, -memory session state.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: rstudio_compare_user_settings() prints short, readable summary default (many settings match, plus grouped list differs) instead raw waldo::compare() dump. Use new output argument control verbosity: "concise" (default), "minimal" (counts ), "verbose" (full waldo::compare() output debugging). New source argument ("auto", "live", "file") controls “current” settings read: live via rstudioapi (requires running RStudio session), saved rstudio-prefs.json file disk, automatically picking whichever available. rstudio_compare_user_settings() now works without running RStudio session, comparing saved rstudio-prefs.json file instead failing. Settings left RStudio’s built-default (therefore absent file) backfilled locally installed RStudio’s preference schema, ’re longer misreported “missing” — including nested settings like panes$hiddenTabSet.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: rstudio_reset_user_settings() rstudio_set_preferences() now work called outside RStudio (e.g. via Rscript), merging preference JSON files directly instead requiring live rstudioapi session. rstudio_reset_gmc() split rstudio_configure_defaults() (headless-capable: preferences, keybindings, snippets, directories, dictionaries) rstudio_reset_session_state() (requires live RStudio session: tabs, workspace, layout, theme, console, history). rstudio_reset_gmc() remains thin wrapper calling , backward compatibility. Added internal helpers detecting installed (necessarily running) RStudio Desktop version, used support . New get_rstudio_install_scope() reports whether local RStudio Desktop install system-wide (“users”) per-user (“just ”). find_rstudio_install_dir() now looks , checking per-user registry hive Windows previously missed.

title: bio 0.3.1
text: Documentation AI-assistant context files updated match current behavior. Fixed rstudio_delete_spellcheck_dictionaries(ask = FALSE), previously fail removing selected dictionary directory. Fixed open_project() called supplied proj_list proj_list_path. Fixed get_path_rstudio_config_dir() XDG_CONFIG_HOME set appending rstudio sub-directory per XDG Base Directory specification. Added isolated regression coverage dictionary deletion canceled RStudio user-settings resets. Added mocked regression coverage RStudio restart/reload commands spellcheck dictionary installation. Expanded automated coverage across exported package, path, project, file opening, RStudio integration, offline program-information helpers. Fixed clear_r_history() use RStudio’s history commands live RStudio session, including Windows. Clarified bundled rstudio-default preset compiled recent official RStudio settings documentation available 2022; setting comparisons use locally installed RStudio schema available. Added regression coverage open_project() availability filtering duplicate project names outside interactive RStudio session. Updated RStudio Desktop support links Posit’s current support site corrected current Linux/macOS internal-state paths ~/.local/share/rstudio. Updated remaining RStudio documentation links docs.posit.co documented unverified Windows/RStudio command-history reset behavior. Fixed RStudio install-scope classification tests non-Windows runners made per-user path detection separator- path-boundary-safe. Removed retired, commented-implementation experiments package source.
